description: Salary for a job title: how much a role pays, from open postings that publish pay, on about 20,000 company job boards crawled twice a day. Optional location, remote and currency. Returns yearly p10/p25/median/p75/p90, the typical posted range, remote vs on-site medians, the five top-paying companies and the posting count. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

currency.description: Currency (USD, EUR...); default the commonest among matches

title.description: Words in the job title; comma-separate alternatives (data engineer,analytics engineer)

name: jobs_salary
